rights.owner_decision: Owner reply 2026-11-03: use the State Commission minutes, publishing national figures only, on § 5(a) and (b). Findings of 2026-11-04 narrow how that basis is described and are flagged for owner review.
findings: § 5(a) and (b) read the same in the 2019 and 2023 versions, so correcting the version changes the citation, not the wording.

Act 180/2014 § 69 calls this document minutes (zápisnica) and requires the State Commission to publish overall results. Nothing read classifies it as an official decision (úradné rozhodnutie), so § 5(b) is not relied on as settled.
The published figures are facts the State Commission must publish, which supports § 5(a). § 5(a) concerns information within a work and does not by itself clear a selection or a dataset.

The database right (§ 135) arises only with a substantial investment in a database. It was not established whether the minutes are a database. § 138(3) permits extracting an insubstantial part; the national section is 2 of 69 pages, yet it may be qualitatively substantial, so that exception is not assumed.
limits: This is a reading of the statute, not advice from a lawyer or a statement by the State Commission. No licence or written permission exists.
The 1 February 2023 version was read as named by the owner; whether a later amendment took effect before 30 September 2023 was not checked.
ŠÚ SR files on volby.statistics.sk were not used. Those terms prohibit robots and similar tools, and their CC BY 4.0 grant names www.statistics.sk.
Legal challenges to the 2023 result were not reviewed.

rules.thresholds: § 66 (1) Štátna komisia zisťuje, koľko platných hlasov celkovo bolo odovzdaných pre každú politickú stranu a koalíciu. (2) Štátna komisia ďalej zisťuje, a) ktoré politické strany získali menej ako päť percent z celkového počtu odovzdaných platných hlasov, b) ktoré koalície zložené z dvoch alebo troch politických strán získali menej ako sedem percent z celkového počtu odovzdaných platných hlasov, c) ktoré koalície zložené najmenej zo štyroch politických strán získali menej ako desať percent z celkového počtu odovzdaných platných hlasov.
rules.allocation: § 68 Prideľovanie mandátov (1) Súčet platných hlasov odovzdaných pre postupujúce politické strany alebo koalície sa vydelí číslom 151. Číslo, ktoré vyšlo týmto delením, zaokrúhlené na celé číslo je republikovým volebným číslom.
